candidate.command: SF_BENCHMARK=true JAVA_HOME=<JDK17> mvn -pl streamfusion-runtime surefire:test -Pbench -Dsf.testForks=1 -Dtest=WindowBasicTypeBenchmark -Dwindow.cases=extrema_boolean,extrema_time,extrema_date -Dwindow.phases=ONE_PHASE,TWO_PHASE -Dwindow.shapes=TUMBLE,HOP,CUMULATE,SESSION -Dwindow.rows=1000000 -Dwindow.keys=64 -Dwindow.warmup=2 -Dwindow.runs=3 -Dsf.extraJvmArgs=-Xmx2g -Djava.library.path=<baseline-native-release-directory> (inside sf.extraJvmArgs)

notes: The candidate and origin load the identical frozen release native library; this coverage change only widens Java admission. The SESSION shape executes one-phase only.
Origin is frozen original production code plus identical benchmark fixture; native planning stays enabled with window fallback asserted.
Origin controls run in a separate JVM with their own paired stock controls; preserve drift.
Means retain every measured trial; startup remains included.

Final candidate and baseline use identical benchmark source and resources; origin freezes production source at d85b241a with only benchmark fixtures copied. Native planning remains enabled and window fallback is asserted on origin.
Stock/origin controls run in separate JVMs with their own paired stock controls; all drift and samples are retained. No competing build/test/timing jobs run.
Final native factory uses typed fixed-width extrema and exact scalar pane folding. Other grouped-value prototypes in the candidate build are outside these asserted window plans.
Means retain every measured trial and include startup. Allocation requests and requested bytes are not copied-byte measurements. SESSION runs only in one phase.
